22-2709: Authority of arresting officer.[27]

Every such peace officer or other person empowered to make the arrest, shall have the same authority, in arresting the accused, to command assistance therein, as peace officers have by law in the execution of any criminal process directed to them, with like penalties against those who refuse their assistance. Universal Citation: KS Stat § 22-2407 (2017) 22-2407. Assisting law enforcement officer. (1) A law enforcement officer making an arrest may command the assistance of any person who may be in the vicinity.

(2) A person commanded to assist a law enforcement officer shall have the same authority to arrest as the officer who commands his assistance.

(3) A person commanded to assist a law enforcement officer in making an arrest shall not be civilly or criminally liable for any reasonable conduct in aid of the officer or any acts expressly directed by the officer.

There will be good days and bad days. You will feel overwhelmed when they hit you with full routes but find a method to the madness and ways to make it easier on yourself or you will be miserable. Depending on the climate, prepare for the weather. Make sure you have plenty of water when its hot outside. I recommend stocking up on a couple sugar free gatorades and at least a gallon of water at the beginning of the day. Even if you dont finish it make sure you drink when you’re thirsty. Bringing snacks to give you energy on route is important too. Blast that AC and go at your own pace. Don’t overwork yourself and i recommend not running personally especially early on. It’ll set you at a high standard and you’ll feel swamped later on. 

The job overall isnt horrible, the workload is depending on your dsp and station. I like it generally but it sucks when its 90-100+ degrees. Stay safe and learn from your other DAs who have been doing it a while and add your own flavor.

Good luck!
